[[File:Kodama.png|thumb|250px|Professor Kodama]] '''Professor Kodama''' (Japanese: '''コダマ博士''' ''Doctor Kodama'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP149|Sticking With Who You Know!]]''. Kodama had created a machine, called the "Affinity Enabler", that made {{type|Electric}} Pokémon and {{type|Water}} Pokémon become inseparable. He created it with the intention of making Pokémon who do not get along become closer to each other. Two of the Pokémon affected by his machine were [[Ash's Pikachu]] and [[Dawn's Piplup]]. However, his {{p|Quagsire}} and {{p|Magnemite}} seemed to despise each other even when the machine was turned on. He had hired {{TRT}} as his assistants. They eventually decided to steal the machine, along with Pikachu and Piplup. However, Kodama had also been captured by mistake, which led to Quagsire and Magnemite joining forces in order to rescue him. {{an|Brock}} explained to Professor Kodama that perhaps the machine did not work on Magnemite and Quagsire because they were dual-type Pokémon, with Quagsire's secondary type being {{t|Ground}} and Magnemite's secondary type being {{t|Steel}}. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Professor Kodama |pkmn=Quagsire |type1=Water |type2=Ground |img=Kodama Quagsire.png |epnum=DP149 |epname=Sticking With Who You Know! |vajp=Katsuyuki Konishi |vaen= |desc={{p|Quagsire}} is one of Professor Kodama's assistant Pokémon, however it seemed to have an intense dislike of Professor Kodama's other assistant, a Magnemite, a dislike that was more than mutual and as a result the two Pokémon were always arguing and would occasionally attack each other. After Professor Kodama created the machine that was designed to make {{t|Electric}} and {{type|Water}} Pokémon inseparable, Quagsire and Magnemite were still constantly fighting as it emerged that as Quagsire was part {{t|Ground}} type it was immune to the machine's power. Despite this, Quagsire and Magnemite were able to put their problems behind them to team up and help defeat {{TRT}}. Quagsire's only known move is {{m|Water Gun}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Professor Kodama |pkmn=Magnemite |type1=Electric |type2=Steel |img=Kodama Magnemite.png |epnum=DP149 |epname=Sticking With Who You Know! |vajp=Daisuke Sakaguchi |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Magnemite}} was Professor Kodama's other assistant and returned the hatred that Quagsire felt for it. Magnemite was also immune to the machine Professor Kodama developed due to being part {{t|Steel}} type. Despite this, it was able to team up with Quagsire to defeat Team Rocket which helped resolve some of their issues with each other. Magnemite's only known move is {{m|Thunderbolt}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{electric color light}}|bordercolor={{water color}} |ja=柴田秀勝 ''Hidekatsu Shibata'' |en=Tristan Goddard |es_eu=Rafael Azcárraga |es_la=Pedro D'Aguillón Jr. |fi=Petri Hanttu |fr_eu=Jean-Michel Vovk |cs=Ladislav Cigánek |no=Simen Sand |pt_br=Walter Cruz |pl=Janusz Wituch }} ==Trivia== * Kodama's name is the name of {{wp|Kodama (train)|one of the three Toukai line Shinkansen trains}}. The other two trains are named {{an|Dawn|Hikari}} and [[Zoey|Nozomi]].
